name: Repository Sync
description: Fetches every repo with auto-sync enabled and runs the code indexing pipeline. The per-repo Reindex button bypasses this loop and runs immediately.

name: Code Symbol Enrichment
description: Runs one batch of LLM summarisation against pending code symbols (function / class / method docs).

config_schema.label: batch_size
config_schema.help: Code symbols summarised per scheduled run.

name: Token Blocklist Cleanup
description: Deletes expired entries from the auth token blocklist. Safe to leave on; disable only if you are debugging revocation.

name: Pipeline Failure Cleanup
description: Prunes orphaned pipeline-failure rows and resolved entries older than 30 days. Safe to leave on.

config_schema.label: retention_days
config_schema.help: Resolved failure rows older than this are swept.

name: Graph Orphan Cleanup
description: Prunes entity-graph ghosts — entities and relations that no live memory asserts any more (left by deleted memories). Keeps entity dedup from collapsing fresh entities onto stale ghosts. Safe to leave on.

name: Tag Orphan Cleanup
description: Prunes tags no live memory carries any more (left behind when memories are deleted). Keeps the dashboard tag count and the tag filter from showing unused tags. Switched off here — its scheduled loop will not restart until re-enabled.

name: Expired Memory Cleanup
description: Deletes memories past their expires_at TTL. Dependents pointing at a doomed row via superseded_by are demoted to deprecated first, per chk_superseded_has_pointer.
last_summary: failed: chk_superseded_has_pointer violation, 1 dependent memory was not demoted before delete

config_schema.label: batch_limit
config_schema.help: Expired rows deleted per sweep (dependents demoted first).
